taxonomyDeclaration.reading: targetAuthority=owner-relative-regular-json-schema + descriptorOwnerField=owner means the mutation LEAF directory is the declared authority for its own payload JSON Schema; the descriptor's payloadSchema is resolved relative to the leaf, not the module or artifact. mutationOrganizationalFacetDirs lists 🧬️schema as optional (never a completeness requirement) — only leaves whose descriptor requires 'json-schema' in requiredLanguageSurfaces must have a file. mutationPayloadSchemaRelativePath() (🧬️schema/🔣️.json) is documented as the scaffold DEFAULT for newly-authored mutations, not the sole valid location; it is a minority pattern among existing leaves.
taxonomyDeclaration.conclusion: The mutation-leaf schema layout is the declared taxonomy authority, not an ad hoc per-contract-directory violation. Each leaf is its own scope/owner with one canonical payload schema referenced by one descriptor field (descriptorCardinality=one-canonical-no-competing-descriptor).

recommendation.summary: The mutation-leaf 🧬️.schema.json-family layout is the taxonomy-DECLARED authority (descriptor-linked, owner-relative, one-canonical-no-competing-descriptor) and should be KEPT as the single owner of each mutation's payload JSON Schema. It is not the per-contract-directory violation this ticket's goal warns about. The real violation is Family G-A: aggregate module-level 🔣️.json union files that hand-duplicate a leaf's payload shape as an independently-maintained (and already drifted) stub, instead of $ref-composing it the way space/gis/vcs already correctly do. The aggregate must become a pure union/discriminator that never carries payload content of its own.
recommendation.decision: keep leaf-owned payload schemas as the single authority; eliminate G-A-style duplicated $defs in aggregate 🔣️.json files in favor of the proven G-B $ref pattern; treat the 505 missing-schema leaves (Family F, mostly 🗄️stdio) and the 60 missing-direct-🦀️.rs leaves (Family H, mostly 🖍️draw) as separate, out-of-scope completeness/structural gaps for other WPs to pick up.
